Pathetic customer service, broken promises, and total radio silence. Avoid Puneet Motors.

I booked a Tata Safari Petrol AT on 13th March 2026 at this dealership. I was given a firm, promised committed delivery date (CDP) of 13th May 2026.

Today is June 18th—we are at Day 85 since booking and nearly a month past the promised delivery date. Forget delivering the vehicle, the dealership has gone completely radio silent. There is absolutely no update on the allocation, no VIN number, and zero transparency.

Worse is the utter lack of professional courtesy and unethical behavior from the staff. Representatives Parekh and Vivek Dhawan have completely ignored my continuous follow-ups and emails. They have chosen to hide behind silence instead of showing the basic decency to reply to a repeat customer.

If you value your peace of mind, your money, and expect professional ethics, do not buy your vehicle from Puneet Motors Mumbai. They treat you well until they take your booking, and then you are entirely abandoned.

featured_reviews.name: Prem B Chhabria
featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the most shocking, frustrating, and downright unacceptable experiences I’ve ever had with a car service center — and this is coming from someone who has interacted with multiple brands and workshops over the years. Puneet Motors is, without question, the worst of them all.

I had handed over my Tata Tiago EV for a minor accident repair and second free service. What followed was two full weeks of silence, zero updates, repeated follow-ups, false promises, and sheer negligence. After multiple reminders, I finally got the vehicle back — and it was nothing short of a disgrace:
•	The car was returned in a filthy, unwashed condition.
•	Interior panels were dusty, the seats were stained, and no basic cleaning was done.
•	The dashboard was misaligned, and despite repeatedly pointing it out, it was never fixed.
•	The windscreen washer fluid was contaminated, leaving a greasy film, and even that wasn’t taken care of.
•	The engine bay was caked in dust, as if the car had been parked under a shed for weeks and simply pushed out without lifting the bonnet.

I raised a complaint directly with Tata Motors, and after all the hue and cry, the car was picked up again with promises from the Service Manager and Body Shop in-charge that the issues would be fully rectified.

What happened next? A repeat of the same pathetic cycle. The car came back a second time in almost exactly the same miserable state — dirty from the outside, dashboard untouched, interior sloppy, and all the issues ignored yet again.

The worst part? The people in charge — the ones who are supposed to be managing customer care — showed an attitude of total indifference. The Service Manager was unreachable, failed to respond to multiple calls and WhatsApp messages, and clearly lacked both competence and accountability. At no point did anyone take genuine ownership of the situation.

This is not a Tata-authorized service experience. This is third-rate, careless, and unworthy of the brand. I’ve now formally requested Tata Motors to permanently transfer my service registration away from Puneet Motors, and I will never take my car back there — not even for an emergency.

If you’re a Tata owner in Mumbai and value your vehicle, your peace of mind, and your time — do not go to Puneet Motors. They have proven to be entirely unreliable, disorganized, and incapable of delivering even the most basic level of service.

A service center is meant to restore your car. Puneet Motors managed to ruin the experience — twice.

featured_reviews.name: Shu Bham
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very disappointing service. I have been trying to resolve an accessories issue for the past 8 months, but no one from the service team is responding properly. I have called many times, yet most of the time no one answers the call. This is extremely frustrating.

At the time of purchasing the car, Rahul sir strongly suggested that I buy the accessories from here, saying they were company-fitted, safer, and that I could come anytime if there was any issue. Unfortunately, the reality is completely different. Even after 8 months of continuous requests, my problem is still not resolved.

This has been a very poor and unprofessional experience. I would strongly suggest other customers buy accessories from outside, where you can easily contact the staff and get parts without wasting months.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Kachhara
featured_reviews.review_text: They probably have very very old stock as my i20 has been giving me a new issue almost every 2 months and its been just 2 years since I purchased it. They gave me a good price and probably thats why i got an older car. Try and avoid Arsh. Modi might be better.

featured_reviews.name: Bhagwati Kachhara
featured_reviews.review_text: Very warm staff. And offer good price. But seems like they keep very old stock. The i20 we purchased 2 years ago has been having issues every two months. Feels like it spends more time in their service center than my house. Very unreliable to take anywhere outside the city as dont know when problems may arise. Bought a creta from Modi 8 years ago and havent faced any reliablity issue even once.

featured_reviews.name: deepak kolekar
featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking for a practical and budget-friendly car, so I visited Arsh Hyundai Sion where Sales Consultant Ismail Mandal suggested the Hyundai Grand i10. After checking the car and understanding its features, I found it perfect for my daily use. The whole experience was smooth and helpful, which made me go ahead with the booking. Highly recommend Arsh Hyundai Sion and Ismail Mandal!

featured_reviews.name: Shreyash Labde
featured_reviews.review_text: Excellent service and professional staff. The team at Arsh Hyundai Sion ensures a smooth and pleasant car buying experience. Highly recommended!
